title: Implement configured orchestration ordinary action path

intent.outcome: Close parent #2696 and children #2697-#2700 in one PR by making configured best-fit orchestration enter the ordinary startup path, compile canonical assignments into typed actions, reconcile returns through existing operations, and prove no-keyword autonomous delegation plus direct-work quietness.
non_goals: Do not add vendor-specific adapters, credentials, provider rankings, schedulers, or a second assignment lifecycle.
Do not treat transported worker output as AW proof or completion authority.
Do not close the behavioral issue with scorer-only, explicit-delegation, or mocked-live evidence.

parent.contribution: GitHub #2696 is the parent; #2697, #2698, #2699, and #2700 jointly define final satisfaction.
parent.closure_boundary: The PR may close the parent only when all four children have present-tense implementation and acceptance evidence.

owned: focused tests, fixtures, reference docs, closure review, and release note for #2696-#2700
effects: Configured orchestrator/best-fit posture becomes consequential without delegation keywords.
Binding non-local assignments expose one revision-bound typed dispatch/export action and continue to forbid local implementation.
Returned work re-enters import, admission, recovery, integration, and proof ownership.
Maintained behavioral evidence distinguishes live availability from deterministic coverage and compares total completion cost.

delegation.reason: Parallel bounded ownership avoids repeated broad reads across startup, procedure, typed-action, and harness domains while preserving one orchestrator integration pass.

next_action: Publish the one-PR closure for #2696 through #2700 and preserve distinct-provider adapter work as explicit optional residue.

claims: Ordinary configured orchestration resolves, acts, and reconciles without delegation-specific prompting while direct work remains quiet.
All #2697-#2700 acceptance criteria are mapped to present evidence before #2696 closure.
requirements: Focused startup, operating-decision, assignment lifecycle, skill topology, generated parity, and external evaluation tests pass.
Maintained no-keyword available-agent evidence executes the projected operation rather than merely mentioning it.
Manual export/import/admission and return failure matrix remain revision-bound and preserve AW-owned proof.
AW implement/proof routing passes for all changed paths, followed by repository-required checks and human-verification boundary.

continuation.residual_intent: Provider-specific adapter work remains outside this lane unless required to prove an available generic route.
